Transport errors and resource lifetime
|-- diagramApi constructs backend before attaching a server
|   |-- Same attach function for configureServer and configurePreviewServer
|   |-- Middleware closes over backend and options
|   `-- httpServer present -> attach sockets + register one-time close listener
|-- Middleware gate precedes namespace lookup and route try/catch
|   |-- Outside /api or /internal boundaries -> next()
|   |-- Classified mutation + http off + no truthy binding header -> 403
|   |   `-- x-canvas-chat-binding bypasses this gate; validation is not shown here
|   `-- /internal passes prefix filter but has no dispatch namespace here
|-- Catch applies to awaited route handler
|   |-- Error object -> message; other thrown values -> request failed
|   |-- Headers already sent -> send error event
|   |   `-- end() only if response is neither destroyed nor writableEnded
|   `-- Headers not sent -> JSON error and status
|       |-- RequestTooLarge: 413; ProjectDiagramConflict: 409
|       |-- ApplicationError: conflict 409; invalid-input 400; binary-source 415
|       |-- ApplicationError: lsp-disabled / ai-disabled / storage-unavailable 503
|       |   `-- Only LSP/AI disabled cases add LSP_DISABLED / AI_DISABLED code
|       `-- Other errors: 400
`-- HTTP server close -> dispose sockets -> backend.dispose()
    |-- Calls dispose methods in order shown centrally; no awaiting or try/finally
    |-- A synchronous throw would interrupt the remaining cleanup calls
    `-- No httpServer -> no close-triggered backend cleanup registered here

Route data and request control flow
|-- Core: /api/core/project
|   |-- files: projectId + path (default '') + optional sourceId
|   |-- source: projectId + path (nullable) + optional sourceId
|   |-- definitions: method guard -> ensure enabled -> read body -> AbortController
|   |   |-- response close -> abort only while !writableEnded
|   |   |-- definitions(body, signal); send 200 only while !response.destroyed
|   |   `-- finally remove close listener
|   `-- corpus-compactions: await requireProject BEFORE GET/POST/405 selection
|       `-- Project validation can fail before an unsupported method reaches 405
|-- Mapping: /api/mapping; delegation needs matching path AND service
|   |-- evals/ needs evalRuns + evalPrompts + evalReferences together
|   |-- generated-canvases base or subtree needs evalRuns alone
|   |-- Other optional services gate their respective families
|   `-- Missing dependency skips that branch; final fallback is 404
|-- Workspace bodies: 64 * 1024 * 1024 byte read limit
|   |-- GET records -> loadRecords(history=current ? current : all)
|   |-- POST records -> applyBatch; POST export -> portableExport
|   |-- POST import-contexts -> prepareImport
|   `-- GET workspace -> load; PUT workspace -> save
|-- Diagram route order has a literal-ID consequence
|   |-- POST diagrams/publish -> publishCheckpoint
|   `-- Other methods reach diagrams/:id matcher with id = publish
|       |-- DELETE -> diagrams.delete('publish'); actual result depends on service
|       `-- Other methods -> 405
`-- POST prompt: prepare(await readBody) before streaming headers
    |-- Status 200; application/x-ndjson; cache-control no-cache, no-transform
    |-- flushHeaders -> selection.run(input, progress callback)
    |-- Event object = {type: 'progress', ...event}; supplied event can override type
    `-- Then result event -> end; thrown errors propagate to transport catch
